notes: [S012.N1] This wholly handwritten continuation has three underlined rubrics: Exemple, NB and Question. It has an interlinear parenthesis with its insertion hook, a cancelled word after section, a cancelled initial at Connaissent-ils, and inline mathematical expressions. There is no new date, salutation, signature, author page number or total. The separate light archive numeral is 11. The hand remains unnamed. H’s external editorial claim about another copy is not evidence from this sheet.

[S012.N2] For a ring A on X, the Example names M and N as the sheaves K^0 and K^1 associated with the additive champ of projective A-Modules, followed by the literal abbreviation v.f. and the inserted parenthesis (p raised-r ex.). It says Mme Sinh’s construction supplies a Picard champ épinglé by M,N, hence a canonical section of the middle term, whose initial remains P/F. The NB asserts the evident functorialities in M,N,X. These are source assertions, not results proved in this run. No variance or additional hypotheses are supplied. The French mathematical term champ is retained in the English notes; it does not mean a field in these categorical passages.

[S012.N3] The Question asks whether the exact triangle and sequence are known to Quillen, Breen, Illusie, and whether they know variantes “supérieures”. The proposed route by n-champs de Picard non néc. stricts is explicitly tentative: pourrait être. These remain questions and a possible approach. No higher-dimensional construction is proved or researched here.

[S012.N4] The references were adjudicated independently: the first has (α), with a low loop and crossed upper tail, while the second has α) and no separate opening parenthesis. H’s asterisks are not supported. The triangle label remains T/J and the middle-term initial remains P/F. These readings come from the cropped strokes, not from the expected exact-sequence notation. No mathematical inconsistency on this page required changing a formula.

[S012.N5] The first abbreviation letter resolves to v because it has two limbs and no crossbar; no expansion is inserted. The final stop after f cannot be separated from a nub on the insertion connector and remains doubtful. The cancelled du/de, old S/X, and the isolated high mark after the first reference remain unresolved. A separate short dash after et is clear. The wording construction, pour en obtenir, sont ils, Connaissent-ils, abbreviations and paired high quotation strokes are kept as written.

No source whole or half was viewed by main. Six loci remain unresolved. The crop-location part of v09 worked.
